measurement.counted_event: Each distinct proof label for The Stop Line proof page recorded as completed during the measurement period, tied to a specific approved or release-eligible public AI claim, proof asset or proof-page item, with observable label text, proof type, completion date, page or asset scope and duplicate boundary recorded in the proof-label completion register.
measurement.exclusions: Exclude draft, proposed, incomplete, missing, duplicate or placeholder proof labels; labels not tied to The Stop Line proof page, its proof items or its release-eligible proof assets; and records outside the measurement period. Do not exclude completed eligible proof labels because a separate approval check, publication, meeting click, download, engagement, campaign-quality requirement or unrelated governance requirement failed.

additions.metric: Recognition of The B Team as a proof-led AI engineering partner

measurement.denominator: Sampled owners of midsize businesses and technical buyers in the first message-testing wave before launch who are asked the recognition item for The B Team as a proof-led AI engineering partner behind The Stop Line and have a valid opportunity to answer.
measurement.exclusions: Exclude respondents outside the owners-of-midsize-businesses or technical-buyer audiences, duplicate respondent records, test or staff records, records outside the first message-testing wave before launch, and records with no opportunity to answer the recognition item. Do not exclude eligible respondents because they do not recognise The B Team, choose another association, give a negative answer, lack meeting intent, or fail unrelated campaign governance or quality requirements.
measurement.numerator: Denominator respondents whose answer recognises The B Team as a proof-led AI engineering partner, meaning the response attributes The B Team to AI engineering and to proof-led evidence, approved proof, traceable claims, senior responsibility or visible limits rather than only to generic software delivery, broad AI capability or unrelated awareness.

limitation: Recognition now has a direct first-wave baseline measure. Later-wave comparability is a separate remaining question; this atom does not claim all future semantic judgments are correct.
